I'm a biologist working to tackle contemporary biodiversity challenges through genetics, ecological observations, eco-evolutionary modelling, and theoretical development. I'm striving for a holistic understanding of biological systems, and spend most of my time being humbled by their complexity.

My latest work has been leading a collaboration to advance our methods and understanding of how tropical fishes might respond to climate change by moving, adapting, or going extinct. Check out our [preprint here](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.03.03.707980 "Unexpected global biodiversity responses to climate change arise from complex adaptation, seascape, and dispersal dynamics").
